1_objects_spaces.generic: Real-valued potential and weight sequences indexed by Nat.
1_objects_spaces.distance: Arbitrary trajectory x:Nat->E and comparator u:E in a NormedAddCommGroup. Source Euclidean space is a specialization; normed-group generality is an explicit algebraic strengthening.

seven_semantic_slots.2_quantifiers_order: Universally quantified a,w,T and hT>0; distance universally quantified E/instance,x,u,eta,T with hT>0 and forall t<T eta(t)>0. No existential trajectory or optimizer and no algorithm choice is hidden.
seven_semantic_slots.3_assumptions_regularity: Generic: only positive natural horizon. Distance: normed additive commutative group, positive horizon and each played step positive. No monotonicity, bound, diameter, differentiability, convexity, feasibility or update law is needed for the algebraic identity. Positive eta is retained to express the source contract even if bare totalized-field algebra can be stronger.
seven_semantic_slots.4_conclusion_metric: Exact finite weighted difference sum equals initial weighted potential minus terminal weighted potential plus internal changes of weights times the next potential. Source specialization uses squared norm distances and reciprocal steps, retaining the terminal x(T) term.
seven_semantic_slots.5_constants_normalization: Source factor1/2 retained in denominators and interior sum. Lean index0=source round1; Lean x(T)=source x_(T+1); last played step eta(T-1)=source eta_T. Interior indices range(T-1). No asymptotic notation, hidden constants or terminal dropping.
seven_semantic_slots.6_probability_feedback: Deterministic pathwise identity, no probability/filtration/stopping time. Generic arbitrary trajectory does not itself prove an algorithm guarantee. Actual OGD and legal policy OSD specialization will be established by complete canaries and existing trajectory interfaces, separately from the algebra.
seven_semantic_slots.7_boundary_exclusions: T=0 excluded in these exact headers. Optional zero-horizon extension is not a source obligation and is not included. Source adapter excludes nonpositive played eta. Generic weights and potentials may be signed or zero, terminal unconstrained. Unbounded domains allowed. No regret bound or diameter premise is inferred from identity alone.
